fact: Regulation No. 585/2026, approved by the Council of Ministers and reported on 10 March 2026, established the Universal Access Fund financed by a mandatory 1.5% contribution on the annual gross revenue of licensed telecom operators, collected and deployed by the Ethiopian Communications Authority.
title: Ethiopia Unveils Groundbreaking Fund to Bridge Rural Digital Divide, Imposes 1.5% Telecom Revenue Levy
